prompt: A Java service limits each user to 60 requests per minute using two Redis commands. Which pairing implements the counter correctly?
explanation: INCR creates and bumps a per-minute counter atomically, and EXPIRE attached only when INCR returns 1 (the first hit of the window) makes the whole window lapse after sixty seconds. Expiring on every increment would keep pushing the window forward and starve the user.

options.text: INCR ratelimit:user:42, then EXPIRE ratelimit:user:42 60 only when INCR returns 1
EXPIRE ratelimit:user:42 60 after every INCR, so the key never outlives activity
GET ratelimit:user:42, compare to 60, then INCR if the value is smaller
INCR without any expiry, resetting the key manually once a minute from a scheduler
